The '''ersatz [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]''' was a replacement [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadron led by [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek Klivian]] while the nominal members of Rogue Squadron had resigned their commissions to fight in the [[Bacta War]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].

After the Bacta War, the auxiliary squadron was called [[Red Squadron]] while conversing with Antilles' Rogue Squadron in order to avoid confusion.
